context.p: Use this procedure to configure a development gateway and send a test request.

step.cmd: Open AI Gateways and select Create gateway.
step.info: Use a unique name that identifies the application or environment.

step.cmd: Enter the AI provider endpoint and select the authentication method.

step.info: Confirm that the gateway status changes to Connected.

step.cmd: Create an API key with the Gateway invoke scope.
Send a test request using the API Reference.

result.p: The gateway is ready to accept test requests.

example.title: Verify the configuration
example.p: Confirm that the gateway returns an HTTP 200 response. If the request is blocked, review the security policy and event log.
